batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b MA Starc

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b JA Morkel

batting.name: MK Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b VR Aaron

batting.name: NJ Maddinson
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b Mohammed Shami

balls.text: deep midwicket has a chance this time but Maddinson has rushed in too much and makes a mess of what should have been a simple catch. Low full toss on middle and Duminy hoicked it off the front foot and gets a boundary for his trouble
mauled into the crowd behind deep midwicket! It was the slower ball and he'd picked it early and though the bat turned in his hands, it sailed past the ropes
wide yorker drilled down the ground to bring up the hundred partnership
he's disgusted with himself after missing out on that. Smacks his pad with the bat as this full length ball that was asking to be smashed out of the ground ends up not even getting an edge
full and outside off again as Taylor lashes it right through Yuvi at backward point. But third man mops up
starts off with a full toss that is way too wide to become anything but a boundary through point. Taylor had to reach for it but he did manage to connect it well enough to beat the boundary rider
there were two before it but this is the first one off the middle. Clears his front leg to lash a fullish delivery over the head of Kohli at mid-off
swiped away into the leg side as this is fullish on middle and leg

another slower ball as he rolls his fingers down the side of the ball. Taylor plants his front foot down the line and goes for that big golf swing again. Another outside edge, another third man boundary. Starc throws his head back
knows Taylor was setting up for the fuller ball and gives him a short one. Isn't able to adjust and misses on the pull shot. Kicks the turf in disgust
blindly swings again and this time he gets the benefit of a thick outside edge that scurries away to the third man boundary. That was the offcutter and it did deceive the batsman
heaves down the wrong line and misses out on a length delivery. Starc better be a lot fuller or a lot shorter than that
goes for the slower ball and it ends up a low full toss, Taylor steers it to deep point
that's better. He gets his yorker right and it's quick enough to beat Taylor's lash outside off stump
switches to a slower pace as he goes for the offcutter outside off, Duminy goes back and cuts to deep point
cleared his front leg away to whip the fuller delivery on leg stump away to the square leg boundary. Such quick hands and that's his fifty as well
misses the mark with his length and Duminy gets under it and smacks it beyond the long-off boundary. So clean
full on off stump, drilled past Virat at mid-off but he hares after it and keeps it to a couple
has a giant smile on his face after executing the perfect wide yorker to keep Taylor quiet
low full toss on leg stump, swung away to deep square leg
fires it in full on middle stump as Duminy clears his front leg and squeezes it out to the right of deep midwicket
sets himself up well outside off and Starc bowls it full and further wide, slices it away to deep point
excellent work from Dinda at the third man boundary! Short and wide outside off as he threw his bat at it. Gets a thick outside edge that seemed set for four, but he hunted it down well
slower short ball and Duminy was just a little too exuberant. Mistimes the pull and finds deep square leg
pulls out the scoop, but it wasn't the right ball for it. Leg-stump yorker that wanders through to the keeper. Oh, but wait, he has overstepped!
shortish ball outside off, pulled to deep midwicket
this time there was flight available, but Taylor is not quite comfortable against the slower bowlers. Misses out as his swipe can only reach deep midwicket
punched down the ground to long-on where AB is lurking. No double there
he's concentrating on a quicker pace now after that six. Taylor stays back and cuts behind point.
shortish and darted in on off stump, he shuffles across and works it wide of where mid-on would have been. Yuvi himself rushes after it
peppers the sightscreen after skipping down the track. Yuvi fires in a flatter ball but he get under the ball and muscled it over the top
goes for the late cut, but still can't beat Kohli

that could have been close! It was a shorter ball and he looked to dab it in front of point for a quick single. Kohli swoops on the ball and sends in the throw in one motion. Rosco has to pull out a full-length dive as well and it saves him, just about
this almost turned square! Loads of flight just outside off and lured the batsman into pushing at it. Gripped the deck and spun well past the outside edge
rocks back and cuts to deep point
such lovely drift he's getting. Sneaks in towards leg stump but it gets some turn after pitching and takes the outside edge towards point
googly to start and this time Duminy is aware of it, goes back and punches it down to long-off
flighted on middle, Duminy pushes it down the ground to long-on. That's the second and final strategic time out of the innings
stays a bit low as he tosses it up outside off. Goes on with the arm as JP bottom edges it
loads of flight on this as Taylor lashes to the sweeper
quicker and flatter on off stump, he goes back and punches to long-on
shortish and outside off, he rocks back and cuts to deep point
comes down the track to take advantage of the flight. Meets it on the full and whips it between long-on and deep midwicket
full and outside off, Duminy pushes to long-off
wide yorker draws him forward as he steers it off the open face to the sweeper
neatly picked away as Dinda goes off line. It was the slower ball off the back of the hand. Taylor knew fine leg was inside the circle and glances it away
keeps it right up there on off stump, Taylor's forward and drives it through the covers. Starc is very good in the deep as he slides down on it and and throws the ball in one motion
goes for the wide yorker but he toes outside the marker
opens the face to slice this full delivery outside off to deep cover
drills the low full toss to the sweeper. He's starting to look comfortable out there
flighted on off stump and it skids quite low onto the bat, Taylor pushes to long-off

shortish and outside off, Taylor goes back and cuts to point who misfields and the two batsman hesitate in the middle of the pitch wondering if they should go for the single. By the time the ball is taken control of though, they rush through for the single
strides down the track and succeeds in getting it to deep midwicket
the wrong 'un dips on him and Duminy who was expecting the leg spinner was looking for a nudge to midwicket and misses
drifts it in on off stump and then snares some lovely turn away from the bat. Taylor opens the face and plays it with soft hands into the covers
picked away off his toes as Dinda search for the blockhole ends up a half-volley. Couple to the left of long-on
full and outside off, Duminy pushes to mid-off who has a shy at the stumps and gives away an overthrow
digs it in short but it doesn't rise high enough. Duminy is in position for the pull and keeps it down nicely. Deep square leg runs around to his right to cut it off
low full toss shaping in at off stump, Taylor was forward and punches to long-off
pulls the pace off it this time as he attempts an offcutter which he angles across the left-hander. Duminy steers it down to third man
back of a length and outside off, Taylor is back and punches into the covers to bring up the fifty
he was backing away and ended up struggling to reach a googly that was pitched short and spinning wider of him. Can't beat point
stays deep in his crease and late cuts it down to deep third man
that stayed so low! Gripped the pitch and turned down the leg side and deceived both the batsman and the keeper

comes down the track and looks to whip through the on side, but this is the wrong 'un and he gets a leading edge that just lobs over the bowler. Chahal leaped as high as he could, but he was just not tall enough
Chahal throws himself to his left and stops the attempted single as Duminy nudged down the ground.
stays back to try and read the turn off the deck and dabs it in front of point for a single
tossed up nicely on off stump, he hits it with the turn to deep midwicket
wide yorker, Duminy nudges into the covers and races off for the single
taps and runs to point as he rides the bounce on this shortish ball outside off
full and slid across him, driven through to the sweeper

145kph, another terrific bouncer. Duminy is way too late on the hook shot and it was way too high to control it too. Rose to the crest on the helmet, but the top edge falls just short of the onrushing keeper
presents an angled blade to the back of a length ball outside off. Can't beat point
back of a length and outside off, steered to deep third man
nice, tight line on off stump. Duminy is forward and blocks
thick outside edge that evades the slips. Taylor was bringing a closed defensive face down on the ball and is deceived
flighted on middle, Taylor plants his bat in front of pad and defends
more turn for his leggies. It's the kind that is just enough to trouble the batsman. Taylor looks to defend and is beaten
googly to the new batsman and Taylor had no clue. Gets an inside edge onto pad but there was no short leg

Vijay's beaten and the off stump is knocked back! What a way to debut for your new franchise! It was a rapid legspinner which drifted in on middle and straightens just enough after pitching. Vijay was looking to guide it down to third man again. A lot of bemused looks as they check if it was bowled or stumped or if the keeper disturbed the bails. The third ump is roped in and replays show he is bowled neck and crop
fires in a yorker just outside off and Vijay guides it to deep third man and we'll have the first strategic time out
this time he slaps it into the gap in the covers, but there is protection in the deep. Shouldn't offer width if he goes back of a length
slapped away to point and Yuvi tumbles to his right to halt it in its tracks
short ball angled at leg stump, JP moves across to the off side to pull it down to fine leg but doesn't connect
back of a length and slanting down the leg side, the glance doesn't connect and the keeper makes a hash of it to allow an extra run in addition to the wide
145kph, that's some excellent aggression from the quick bowler. Saw the batsman backing away and followed him with a bouncer.
lazy waft outside off and he's beaten again. Aaron goes fishing outside off stump and gets a bit of away swing to bolster his case, but the edge is not forthcoming
shortish on middle and off, Vijay stands up tall and blocks
fullish and angling in at him, Vijay is forward and flicks away to deep midwikcet
corrects slides it off the open face to deep third man for a single
gorgeous shot! Didn't do much more than present a full face to the overpitched delivery but he had just timed it so well
goes slower, think it was the offcutter. Vijay is wise to it and drops it into the off side for a quick single
good length ball on off stump, Vijay comes forward and blocks to mid-on. A ricochet off the stumps at the bowler's end fetches an overthrow
short fine leg makes a mess of it. He had to move to his left a bit but the ball sneaks under his dive. Albie is not pleased as Vijay's flick gets four more than it deserved
that's a wicket-maiden. Aaron digs this is short and gets it to rise around chest-high. Duminy dead bats it into the leg side.
good length and angled in at middle. Turned away to square leg
short of a length and outside off, Duminy looks to run it down the third man but doesn't get the requisite amount of bat on it
nice little stroke. Covered his stumps and angled the shortish ball outside off to point. Very compact
back of a length and outside off, JP shoulders arms

what a soft dismissal, caught down the leg side! Kohli high-fives his bowler and Bangalore are jubilant. Tiwary shuffled across to try and glance it fine but the ball, just short of a good length, runs off the face and Parthiv collects another simple catch
more shape away and Vijay was left groping at it. No foot movement as he hung his bat and the good length ball darts across the outside edge
skips down the track as Albie fires at his pads, Tiwary the new batsman, gets an inside edge that wanders into the leg side
back of a length and outside off, left alone

golden duck for the captain! What a ripper from Albie! Gets one to straighten and extracts a bit more bounce as well. All that combine to claim a faint edge as Karthik prodded forward and the keeper did the rest
too straight and Vijay is comfortable clipping it away to deep square leg
back of a length on off stump, Vijay covers the line and blocks it

he seemed a little too generous with that pull shot despite being late on it once before. Starc digs it in and it comes in at an awkward bounce, there is also a bit too much pace on the ball and he splices it to square leg
shortish and angled across him, Agarwal made room outside leg and looks to carve it over point. Beaten
nicely bowled, but Vijay negotiates the inswing well. Clips into the midwicker region for a single
pulls his length back a bit and directs the ball wider of off stump, Vijay prefers not to play

picked away, that's a Vijay special! It was full and on the pads, a very strong area for the opener. Ensured his front foot was not in the way and an effortless whip of the wrists sends the ball beyond the square leg boundary
145kph, that's his main threat and he almost had his man. Fullish and curling in rather late. Agarwal had to adjust his shot and block and gets more of an inside edge
fullish and just outside off, strides forward and defends to point. Yuvraj sends in a throw at the non-strikers'
shortish and outside off, dabbed behind point for a quick single

poor shot selection there. Keeps it back of a length and refuses him any room to free those arms. Agarwal is on the front foot and goes for a flat-batted pull. Hits high on the bat and drops just short of mid-on
back of a length and angled in at him, clipped off his thighs to deep square leg
fullish and outside off and Morkel even gets a bit of nibble away. Vijay leaves it watchfully
starts off short and it's pulled to deep midwicket. Seemed a little cramped there which limited his timing a bit
some late inward movement again but Vijay negotiates it well with a front foot defensive
dug in short on middle, defended
walks at the bowler as Starc manages a bit of inward dip. Agarwal uses it and flicks through midwicket
strides forward and drills another solid drive into the covers
slices it to deep third man who slaps the ball back into the field of play. Full and slated wide again. Had to reach for it
teases the batsman outside off again but he goes a bit too far there
crisply punched into the covers as he leans forward to the fuller delivery angled across him
races down the track and lofts it down towards long-on. Falls short of Vijay who was diving forward. They pick up the runs needed to pick up the victory and a very comprehensive one at that
flighted on off stump, he lunges forward to block and picks up a single square on the off side
that's a full toss over the waist and he has pulled it over short find leg to take him to his fifty on Bangalore debut
terrible line from Nadeem. On the pads and he's swept him miles into the boundary behind square leg. Yuvi against this kind of spin is no contest at all.
low full toss to start his spell and Kohli drives to long-on
long-on watches it clear his head and thud into the advertising boards. Pitches it up in his arc and Yuvi's big back lift comes down in a thunderous swing
another slower bouncer and though Yuvi goes through with the shot this time he has trouble connecting
spears it in on middle and he was looking to clip to midwicket. Gets a leading edge to point. Squared Yuvi up there. Shami's been brilliant today
slower short ball and he's deceived Yuvi. Set up for the pull shot and then realises it was not coming on and just lets it through to the keeper
overpitched outside off, Kohli's flashing blade gives work for the sweeper
slower ball outside off, Yuvi waits for it and thumps it to deep cover
short again but this was just a touch quicker and Yuvi pulls to long-on. That is now the strategic time out
backs away to the flatter ball outside off and chops it to cover
drags it short as he fears Yuvi's trip down the track. But it was such a long hop that he has time to pull it to the long leg boundary
stays back as he knows this will be flatter and clips it to deep midwicket

this one is hit with the turn and he's raises the fifty partnership with a glorious shot over extra cover. Didn't get to the pitch as much as the last ball and had to sort of reach for it, but his timing was still top-notch
and he's sent packing over long-on. Races down and gets to the pitch. Doesn't bother about how it's going to turn and just launches it into the night sky
fullish and outside leg stump and Yuvi's helped it on its way. Lands among the Bangalore players in the dug out and he has a big smile on his face while punching gloves with his captain
full on off stump, Kohli drills it down to long-on
outside edge off the slower ball outside off. Tries to steer it down to third man but it bounces short of the keeper
waist-high full toss and Yuvi swipes it away to deep square leg
whipped away into the leg side as those strong wrists take over
do not drop me, says Kohli with a punishing six over extra cover. Overpitched outside off and he waded into the shot and timed it perfectly
another drop and it's Agarwal in the square boundary on the off side. Raced down the track and slapped a short ball hard and flat. the fielder had to run in and come forward but he spills it
skips down the track but the ball seems to stop on the pitch before reaching him. Gets hit high on the bat as he pushes into the covers. Fell not too far away from the fielder either
bit of room on offer and he essays a late cut to find deep third man
stays back to steer the good length ball behind point

that's a dolly and he's dropped it at short fine leg! Neesham, what have you done?! Clipped uppishly but straight to the man, at abound waist high and at a very comfortable pace coming at him. But it pops in and then pops out
big ol full toss and Kohli has calmly slapped it away to the sweeper
another back of the hand slower ball which Yuvi steers behind point and Kohli scurries through for a quick single
comes down the track and carves a full and wide delivery to point

that sat up for Yuvi and he's walloped it to the square leg boundary. Neesh bowls waist-high short ball and it was the slower one as well. Comfortably dispatched. The ball seems to have caught the cables of the spider-cam and usually it provides grounds for a dead ball, but the umpires give a little leeway
looks to ramp it to third man as he waits for the short ball, but does it a second longer. Not pleased with himself
skips down the track and thumps it down to long-off. The bat turns in his hands, Kohli's timing hasn't been all that impressive in this innings
tapped away through the covers. Sharma tries to toss this up outside Kohli's reach as he was advancing but it was easily controlled
charges him again and he yorks himself. Jams the bat down on the ball and collects a single to point
strides down the wicket to block the flighted delivery that is pushed across him
full toss on off stump, Kohli flicks to deep midwicket. Took the toe end there

blazed down the ground! Another one that's flighted on off stump and it was struck with considerable disdain. Vijay had to pull out a top effort to stop that. Kohli was in trouble of being beheaded there
away she goes. Flat, hard and just over the ropes. Sharma flighted it on leg stump and he swung for the fences
fullish on off stump, he goes forward and blocks into the covers. Searches for the single to keep strike but Yuvi says no
rock-solid forward defensive from Kohli at the other end
stands and hoicks and the bat turns in his hands and he skies the ball over the slips. Taylor ran back but couldn't get under it
goes fullish on leg stump and Yuvi is rooted to the crease as he blocks
that was a snorter of a bouncer. The eyes came off the ball and he was mostly taking evasive action when the bat sort or jutted out and the top edge was taken to run away to the boundary at long leg
short delivery that is just a shade down the leg side. That's rather harsh as the ball sailed over his hips as he was a little cramped up while playing the pull
predictably its the short ball on middle and off stump. Yuvi has to jump off his feet and drop it at his feet with soft hands
gets a bit of turn as he pushes the batsman back in his crease. Flicked to long leg
races blindly down the track and goes for a hack across the line. The ball, a simple one on a good length, sneaks between bat and pad and rattles into off stump
makes room outside leg as he advances and drills the shortish ball through the covers
tossed up on off stump, Kohli lunges forward and blocks into the covers
goes for a big appeal as he sweeps across the line of a good length ball. But the impact was outside off
he almost falls over in his attempt to make room. So much effort into his shots and it only ends up a single to long-off as he flat-bats the short ball
terrible delivery as he bowls it flat and well down the leg side. Parthiv looks to help it away, but doesn't succeed
clears his front leg to chop this short ball on middle into the covers
flighted on middle but he had come down the track and made room for himself to drive to long-off
skids in with the arm, but it had started short and Kohli slaps it away to the sweeper
comes down the track and thumps it into the covers
flights outside off and gets a bit of turn off this deck. Kohli is lured into poking at it and it goes down to point
punched to the right of long-on as they milk the offspinner
judges the ball to be short and he waits on the back foot before whipping it down to long-on
flatter delivery on middle and off, Kohli's wrists though work the ball to deep square leg
a little too straight with a good length ball and Kohli clips it away to long leg
shimmies down the pitch but he pulls the length back and Kohli can only nudge it to square leg
goes on with the arm as Kohli taps it to backward point
flighted on off stump, Kohli calmly pushes it to long-on to raise his team's fifty. That's also the strategic time-out
pushed through on off stump as Parthiv taps it into the covers and goes to the other end
pulls out the sweep and it's timed extremely well. He's not bothered with keeping the ball down and why should he when he hits it in the gap
he was moving outside off again and Nadeem follows him with a fuller delivery. The slash doesn't beat point
bowls a terrible long hop and Parthiv shuffles across and mauls it miles into the square leg boundary. Kohli enjoyed that. Smacked it out of the ground and we need a new ball
flat delivery to start off and Kohli stays on the back foot and pushes to long-off
spots the batsman charging and digs it in short, but makes the mistake of bowling wide. Parthiv slaps it over point. Thumping boundary
143kph, shortish and angled across him, Kohli looks to steer it down to third man but bottom edges it. The non-striker sees the ball going into a gap behind the wickets and rushes up for a single
full and angled across him, Kohli swings from the crease and gets a thick outside edge that flies away to the third man boundary, despite Rahul Sharma's tumbling effort
hint of seam away and Kohli has to check his back-foot punch into the covers
gets back in line with the shortish ball and flicks to midwicket
fullish and around the off stump, defended off the front foot
goes down again and it made an awkward clink as it struck the bat on the splice. Just about clears a back-pedaling mid-off and scurries away
what a response! Charges him and pummels the fuller delivery to the long-on boundary.
139kph, another terrific bouncer! Parthiv continues taking it his hook shot had no chance of connecting. Little question asked but he hadn't touched that
this one doesn't rise and Parthiv latches onto a pull to deep midwicket
I though that hit the thigh pad but the umpire reckons there was no contact. Back of a length down the leg side. He goes for the flick and has no success connecting
his shot selection is better this time but Shami manages a bit of seam away from this back of a length delivery and beats him again
140kph, just too much pace. Angles a bouncer across him and Parthiv looks to drag it into the leg side with a pull. Comfortably beaten
this time the pull doesn't quite work, a bottom edge onto the body as he throws his bat at that one
a yorker from Parnell, 140.4kph, Parthiv gets his bat down in time to keep that one out
Parthiv defends this one
this is a shot Parthiv plays well, the ball is dropped short by Parnell, Parthiv is quickly onto it, pulling it away in front of midwicket for four
drops it shorter, defended for a single, and there is amisfield as there's some awkward bounce for Mayank Agarwal
short of length ball outside off, defended towards point
great effort from the keeper Karthik there, flinging himself to his left to nearly grab that one off Kohli, who just glanced that leg-side delivery
there's the first wicket for Delhi, a shortish ball down the leg side, wasn't the most threatening delivery, Maddinson wanted to pull that away, can only glove it away, easy catch for the keeper
again not given much room for Maddinson, following him on legstump, defended
beaten outside off, great line there, bounce as well as he drops it a touch shorter
cramps up Maddinson, back of length once more, Maddinson squirts that away to the leg side
short of length ball from Shami, nurdles the ball towards square leg for a single
blocked off the back foot towards point
Maddinson has a reputation for being a hitter, he starts off his innings by skipping down and launching the ball over the off side, in front of point  for four
first run for Bangalore, steered towards cover
pushed towards cover this time
looking to push this towards mid-on, misses and is hit on the pads, that was sliding down
length ball is pushed back towards the bowler
